text: windowManager mein createMainWindow call hone ke baad setScreenContextProtection enable kar dena
transcript: window manager में create main window call होने के बाद, set screen context protection enable कर देना।

text: bhai resolveTranscriptionRoute function check karo aur byokFileSizeLimit verify kar lo
transcript: by resolve transcription route function check करो, और by ok file size limit verify कर लो।

text: hotkeyManager ke andar normalizeToAccelerator helper lagao taaki isRightSideModifier handle ho sake
transcript: hot key manager के अंदर normalize to accelerator helper लगाओ। ताकि इस right side modifier handle हो सके।

text: useAudioRecording mein stopRequestedDuringStartRef reset karo aur pastesInFlightRef count check karo
transcript: use audio recording में stop request during start web reset करो और। press in flight ref count check करो।

text: ReasoningService ke start mein assertReasoningAllowedByPolicy call karo aur hasLanCleanupConfiguration check karo
transcript: reasoning service के start में assert reason all allowed by policy। call करो और has len cleanup configuration check करो।

text: correctionLearner module mein findEditedRegion run karo aur extractCorrections se list banao
transcript: correction learner module में find edited region run करो। और extract correction से list बनाओ।

text: Linux desktop par spawnWlCopy use karo ya seedha writeClipboardInRenderer execute karo
transcript: Linux desktop पर spawn w one copy use करो और या सीधा। write CLI p board in a render execute करो।

text: database instance par setActiveAccountId set karke noteTextMatchesSnapshot compare karo
transcript: database instance पर set activate account ID set करके note। Text matches snapshot compare.

text: audioManager mein attachTranscript execute karo jab audioExtensionForMime wav return kare
transcript: audio manager में attach transcript execute करो, जब audio extension for my। my mime wave return कर।

text: agar user function key press kare toh isUnsupportedFnCombination flag true return karega
transcript: अगर तुम function की press करें, तो is unsupported fn combination flag true। return करेगा।

text: custom provider ke case mein buildBatchEndpoint se final URL construct hota hai
transcript: custom provider के case में, build backend endpoint से final URL construct होता है।

text: audio pipeline ke andar resolveReasoningRoute call karo aur diff calculate karne ke liye findSubstitutions use karo
transcript: audio pipeline के अंदर resolve reasoning route call और this। calculate करने के लिए find substitutions use करो।
